headings.title: Differential Privacy Reversal via LLM Feedback

topic_explanations: 邻接记录/人必须指定，δ不是一般“失败概率”口语等价；ε相同预算必须sameadjacency，全部训练/选参/发布/非DP通道记账；后处理不额外损DP。
DP-SGD逐样本jointgradient clip→sum+N(0,σ²C²I)→除batchsize→更新。shuffle并每样本更新与Poisson sample minibatch不同，源分别clipw/b联合敏感度不再C；sqrt(steps)代理既非RDP/moments也非正式bound，σ0无privacy不能max(.01)报有限ε。
LoRA减少per-example存储，不使ε自动低、不cover先前nonDPbase训练数据；basepublic/独立假设与privatefine-tune整体输出要区分。
Duan2402.07841是Pile真实预训练MIA160M–12B及member/nonmember分布偏移，不是仅插canary；Panda2503.06808不是Kowalczyk，designedcanary提供privacy下界，未成功攻击不是DP证明。
PMixED使用publicreference与RD-mollifier把privateensemble分布投影再平均/采样；不是简单MoE加Gaussian，不发布privateweights，逐tokenquerycompose。confidence只从DPweights后处理不逆转DP；原DPReversal无一手chain正式剔除。

quiz.question: What does (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy guarantee for a randomized algorithm M?
options: For any two datasets differing in one example and any event S, P(M(D) in S) <= e^epsilon * P(M(D') in S) + delta, so any single individual's contribution cannot be reliably inferred
M is provably equivalent to a non-private algorithm
M does not memorize any training data ever
M is deterministic up to noise
quiz.中文核对: 0公式成立；δ不是所有个人永不泄露几率，邻接说明。

quiz.question: Which is NOT a step of DP-SGD as described by Abadi et al. 2016?
options: Re-randomize the model's tokenizer between steps
Clip each per-example gradient to a threshold C
Sum clipped gradients and add Gaussian noise scaled by sigma * C
Sample a mini-batch and compute per-example gradients
quiz.中文核对: 0 tokenizer不是DP-SGD步骤。

quiz.question: Why is LoRA + DP-SGD the common 2025 configuration?
options: LoRA increases epsilon by design
LoRA removes the need for an accountant
Full DP-SGD on a frontier model is prohibitive; LoRA limits gradient updates to a small adapter, reducing per-example gradient storage while still providing DP guarantees on the adapter
It uses LoRA as a tokenizer
quiz.中文核对: 2可解释adapterstorage，但不是唯一common2025结论或无需privacyaccountant。

quiz.question: How did the March 2025 audit (arXiv:2503.06808) resolve the canary-MIA vs training-data-extraction tension?
options: It eliminated the need for canaries entirely
It showed both measure the same property
It proved DP-SGD is unnecessary
It showed they measure different things: MIA on inserted canaries under-reports memorization because canaries are not optimized to be the 'most extractable' examples that actually matter for privacy
quiz.中文核对: 3错误归因：Panda研究设计更强canaries给audit下界，非Kowalczyk或简单mostextractable等价。

quiz.question: What does PMixED (arXiv:2403.15638) provide as an alternative to DP training?
options: A new accountant for Renyi DP
Inference-time differential privacy via a mixture of experts on next-token distributions, with aggregation noise; avoids DP training entirely
A way to compute epsilon from epsilon-delta accounting alone
A faster DP-SGD variant
quiz.中文核对: 1近方向但方法是publicreference+RDprojection+平均采样，不简单aggregationnoise。

quiz.question: What is the Differential Privacy Reversal via LLM Feedback attack?
options: An attack on tokenizer entropy
A countermeasure to canary insertion
Using a DP-trained model's confidence scores as an oracle to re-identify individuals, even when outputs do not leak directly
A method to reset epsilon to zero
quiz.中文核对: 2无可信一手链，应撤销题干：DPweightsconfidence后处理保DP，freshprivatequery另外记账。
